CivicDataLab | Data, Tech, Design, Social Science We work to strengthen the course of civic engagements using Our Work Climate Action We co-create data collaboratives and tools for effective, data-driven decision making to address climate change. We work closely with multiple stakeholders to institutionalise data and AI capacities, accessibility and usability for public reforms and citizen engagement. Learn more >> DPG&I and Responsible AI We are co-creating people-centric Digital Public Goods (DPGs) and strengthening Digital Infrastructure (DPI) via our Open Data platforms, Data Exchange platform, Intelligent Data Science models, Al-enabled Chatbots and Citizen-led Apps for improving participatory data-driven governance. Our solutions are focused on making data accessible and usable as well as improving data-tech capacities. They are built on principles of privacy by design and adhere to the national and international applicable laws. Learn more >> Gender & Inclusion We work to bring a gender and inclusion lens to data, technology and public systems, building a more holistic understanding of the diverse needs and experiences of women, girls, persons with disabilities (PwDs), and other marginalised communities. We co-create data-driven tools and approaches with governments and ecosystem partners, while building capacities to integrate gender and inclusion into public planning, finance, and decision-making. Learn more >> Law & Justice We create and curate high quality public datasets in the areas of law and justice. We build open data portals to increase information accessibility and conduct trainings and workshops for our partners to enhance their data and tech capacity. Learn more >> Open Contracting We curate Public Finance data by following the flow of funds through budgets all the way through to public procurements. We are working on building open source tools to track, visualize, and analyze this information. Learn more >> Public Finance We curate Public Finance data by following the flow of funds through budgets all the way through to public procurements. We are working on building open source tools to track, visualize, and analyze this information. Learn more >> Urban Development We are delving into the space of urban governance, where we work towards facilitating citizen engagement through making public information accessible on open data platforms. We also work towards involving the citizens in generating information relevant to their well-being, especially during the time of disasters. Learn more >> Latest Blogs Our Partners our team CivicDataLab works across sectors to increase access to information. We use free and open source tools to collaborate and co-create with social change makers. We follow responsible and ethical practices to drive civic engagement and advocacy in the country. Meet the multi-disciplinary team who work behind the scenes to make it all happen! Meet the team >> Work With Us! Let’s co-create the next solution enabling sustainable social change in your area of work Partner With Us Join Us Check our unique Civic Days Write to us at: info@civicdatalab.in License | Site Map Navigate Home Work Team Blogs About Contact Our Events Resources Work DPG&I and Responsible AI Law & Justice Open Contracting Public Finance Urban Development License | Site Map
